_comment: Example ck:test report. One report is written per invocation (except --tdd --prepare, which writes tdd-ready-schema.json instead). Not a JSON-Schema document — an annotated canonical instance, matching this pack's plan-schema.json / ck-quality report-schema.json convention.
_phase: Phase file stem (no extension). For --all-phases, one report per phase, or an aggregate — see mode.
_verdict_rule: BLOCKED means the phase's quality gate was not APPROVED and no test was written or run. FAILED means tests ran and at least one failed, or a tdd-verify run detected a weakened/deleted/modified prepared test.

failures._type_weakened_test: Only for tdd-verify: a prepared test's assertions were loosened, deleted, or narrowed without a corresponding acceptance-criteria change.
failures.expected: Duplicate request returns the existing result

_report_path: Set once the report is written to disk; ck:test always writes one, unlike ck:quality's audit modes.
